title: 017 极乐门徒018 太白分光剑
content_zh:
：崔海客很识时务，跟他的犟种徒弟一点都不一样，几乎可以说是逆来顺受。
杨鲤虽然依旧倔强，但师父是他的软肋，管明晦把崔海客拿捏了，让他往东他就往东。
哪怕他再不愿意撅着嘴堵着气也得往东边去，先到了东边，再气呼呼地等待自己下一步命令。
管明晦让这师徒两个为自己炼黑眚丝。
杨鲤还要抗争拒绝，崔海客趁着管明晦修炼时候偷偷传音给他：“这个妖孽是积年巨擘，你太祖师爷都是他晚辈的晚辈。
他是人间的祸害，自有长眉、极乐那种能人收拾他，不是咱们师徒能够对付得了的。
咱们小心应对，挨到他离开这里。”
杨鲤说：“师父你还真的相信他最后会放我们走吗？师父您不知道，他满嘴谎话，专能骗人，他说出来的一句话都不能相信！”
他小声把自己两次受骗，本想除妖，反倒帮了对方大忙的事说了。
崔海客拍了拍他的头：“他千年跟极乐真人斗智斗勇的时候，你还是上上辈子呢，你被他骗是正常的，别说是你，我也得被他骗。”
“可是，那你还……”
杨鲤不会传音，直接用嘴说话，崔海客知道他要说什么，直接阻止：
“为师这几天暗中推算过，虽然卦象很不明朗，有几宗变数，但咱们师徒只要不违拗他，最终还是能平安回南海的。”
这些话，都被管明晦给听去了，虽然被人背后蛐蛐有点不爽，但他很满意崔海客的态度。
本来他还想着，师徒两个互为软肋，这个不听话收拾那个，那个不听话收拾这个，没想到人家自己先把态度摆正了。
管明晦给他们师徒二人安排下任务，刚开始，每人每天要炼十条黑眚丝，后面熟练了，逐渐增加。
长眉真人的太清神符被破掉了，但还有火云链在。
这链子原著里是被李英琼用紫郢剑削断的，管明晦这段时间用过各方法都不能损其分毫。
用杨鲤那口南海古剑也不行，反而刺激出大量的太阳神焰，若非有万年温玉吸收火气，可要把管明晦烧得够呛。
他如今只能把希望寄托在青索剑上，但是要收青索剑可不是那么容易的。

青索剑被长眉真人随身养炼千年，已经认了峨眉派的功法，又桀骜不驯，即便用峨眉剑诀去收也很难，管明晦用玄阴剑诀去收，必要招到猛烈攻击。
蜀山世界里排行第二的绝世神兵，锋利无比，就算是杨鲤的这把飞剑迎上去，恐怕也要一击而断。
要取青索，管明晦最大的指望还是玄阴聚兽幡，他需要更多更高级的黑眚丝来炼幡，有了崔海客师徒当牛做马，效率能提升不少。
让师徒两个到地肺口那里去采集黑眚地煞，凝练成丝，管明晦腾出手来，坐在床上修养形神，得空了就用万年温玉炼那火云链。
虽然不能把链子破坏，但能令其变长，增加自己的活动范围。
他的目标是延长到地肺里面去，这样他可以在里面布置埋伏，如果华瑶崧真的找上来，就阴她一下子！
过了才数日，华瑶崧没等来，把陆敏等来了。
原来自那日崔海客离开以后，陆敏就在反思，是不是哪里搞错了。
崔海客跟他也是新近结交的，并非老友故交。
因崔海客擅长炼药，为人又谦和，见陆敏是玄门正宗，师承极乐真人，有意亲近，双方算是一见如故。
陆敏在气头上怀疑过崔海客跟杨鲤师徒两个都擅长采阴补阳，祸害了自己女儿以后，还能保持纯阳之身，让人看不出来。
content_en:
: Cui Haike is very aware of current affairs. He is completely different from his stubborn disciples. He can almost be said to be resigned to the situation.
Although Yang Li was still stubborn, his master was his weakness. Guan Minghui had Cui Haike under control and told him to go eastward.
Even if he didn't want to pout and choke, he still had to go to the east. He would get there first, and then wait angrily for his next order.
Guan Minghui asked the master and apprentice to refine black silk for him.
Yang Li still wanted to fight and refuse, so Cui Haike secretly sent a message to Guan Minghui while he was practicing: "This evildoer is a long-standing giant, and your Taizu and Master are all his juniors.
He is a scourge in the world, and there are capable people like Long Eyebrow and Ji Le who can deal with him. It is not something that our masters and disciples can deal with.
Let's deal with it carefully and wait until he leaves here. "
Yang Li said: "Master, do you really believe that he will let us go in the end? Master, you don't know, he is full of lies and can deceive people. You can't believe a word he says!"
He whispered that he had been deceived twice, and that he wanted to get rid of the demon, but instead he helped the other party a lot.
Cui Haike patted his head: "When he was fighting wits and courage with Master Ji Le for thousands of years, you were still in a previous life. It's normal for you to be deceived by him. Don't say it was you, I had to be deceived by him too."
"But, then you still..."
Yang Li couldn't transmit sounds and spoke directly with his mouth. Cui Haike knew what he was going to say and stopped him directly:
"My master has made secret calculations in the past few days. Although the hexagram is very unclear and there are several variables, as long as our master and disciple do not disobey him, we will eventually be able to return to Nanhai safely."
These words were all heard by Guan Minghui. Although he was a little unhappy about being caught behind his back, he was very satisfied with Cui Haike's attitude.
He originally thought that the master and the disciple were each other's weak points. If one disobeys, the other will be punished, and if the other disobeys, the other will be punished. However, he did not expect that he would correct his attitude first.
Guan Minghui assigned tasks to the two masters and apprentices. At first, each of them had to practice ten black silk threads every day. As they became more proficient, the number gradually increased.
Master Changmei's Taiqing Talisman was broken, but the Fire Cloud Chain was still there.
In the original work, this chain was cut off by Li Yingqiong with the Purple Ying Sword. No matter how many methods Minghui used during this period, he could not damage it at all.
Yang Li's ancient sword from the South China Sea didn't work either. Instead, it stimulated a large amount of sun flames. If it weren't for the tens of thousands of years of warm jade absorbing the fire, Guan Minghui would be burned to death.
Now he can only place his hope on the Qingsuo Sword, but it is not that easy to collect the Qingsuo Sword.
Qingsuo Sword has been raised and trained by Changmei Master for thousands of years. He has recognized the Emei Sect's skills and is unruly. Even if he uses the Emei Sword Technique, it is difficult to use it. If Guan Minghui uses the Xuanyin Sword Technique to stop it, he will inevitably be attacked fiercely.
The second most powerful magic weapon in the world of Shushan, it is extremely sharp. Even if Yang Li's flying sword were to hit it, it would probably be broken with one blow.
To get Qingsuo, Guan Minghui's biggest hope is the Xuanyin Gathering Beast Flag. He needs more higher-grade black silk to refine the flag. With Cui Haike as master and apprentice, the efficiency can be improved a lot.
Let the master and the disciple go to Di Fei Kou to collect the Black Widow Di Sha and condense it into silk. Guan Minghui frees up his hands and sits on the bed to cultivate his form and spirit. When he has free time, he will use the Ten Thousand Years Warm Jade to refine the Fire Cloud Chain.
Although the chain cannot be destroyed, it can be lengthened and increase its range of activities.
His goal is to extend into the lungs of the earth, so that he can set up an ambush inside. If Hua Yaosong really comes to find her, he will attack her!
Only a few days later, Hua Yaosong didn't wait, so Lu Min came.
It turned out that since Cui Haike left that day, Lu Min had been reflecting on whether he had made a mistake.
Cui Haike and he were also newly acquainted, not old friends.
Because Cui Haike was good at refining medicine and was a humble man, he saw that Lu Min was an authentic sect of Xuanmen and was a disciple of Master Ji Le, so he wanted to get close to him, and the two of them hit it off.
In anger, Lu Min suspected Cui Haike and Master Yang Li.Both of them are good at picking up yin and replenishing yang. After harming their own daughters, they can still maintain pure yang bodies, making it invisible to others.
